author: Jordanvk23
body:
Hi everyone,

Just wanted to make somewhat of a formal complaint about my person being kicked for no reason.

I'm not trying to sound butthurt, though I admit I might be just that, but I have been kicked out of a game for "Team spleefing".
I do not find it necessary to name the mod who is responsible for such action, but I'm just writing about it because I thought it was
quite unfair, though I understand mods can make mistakes which is another reason for not calling out names here. All I want is for
mods to be slightly more careful when making (very) quick calls on something they impossibly could have seen.

Allow me to explain the situation I found myself to be in. 

There I was, trying to build a bridge, dodging hostile arrows flying past my cubed head. All of a sudden I found myself staring into the blackness of the void. "Sure", I thought, "I must have glitched through a block or something." Good thing life never really comes to an end in Minecraft and I was reborn. So I went back to the bridge-to-be and continued placing blocks, once again bending my square body in impossible angles to avoid those pointy sticks flying towards me. This time, however, I witnessed the reason for my sudden discovery of how I'm not capable of flight, leading to my previous fall of doom. An evil so wicked I could hardly stand looking at it, my eyes shaking with fear while trying to make out the figure standing before me. It appeared to be a friend, a companion, a brother-in-arms. But I was deceived. Underneath the friendly appearance, its true nature was hidden. Turns out I was betrayed by one of my own. Not only the blocks coming from my hands, but blocks from my other partners in battle fell victim to our former ally's destruction. Never before were blocks made to no longer exist as tragically as what was happening before my very own eyes. It all seemed so clear to me this time, while proving gravity does indeed exist, once again.

So to make a long story slightly shorter, I reported the player team spleefing us and carried on with the game. Turns out he or she got kicked and justice seemed to have been served. However, the player-of-evil returned and just carried on where he or she left off. I reported the little devil and kept on playing. I must mention reading about the temporary ban directed at the player felt slightly satisfactory. Anyhow, I felt justice was done once again and decided to repair the damages to the bridge the other player was responsible for. I will make this VERY clear: repairing by means of placing blocks in an orderly fashion in order to make the bridge functional again. Never did I break a block. That is when disaster struck me once again. It felt like Mike Tyson mega-punched me in the face. Though in this case it was a kick, not a punch. I was kicked. After falling victim to a demon several times, destiny found another way of tormenting my soul. 

My word of honor as proof of how I did not make anything up, lie or hide anything that could have had anything to do with this case.

Let this be a warning for fellow players to just play and enjoy, but also let play and let enjoy. Mods, please be more cautious when punishing, I mean, who knows, the player you're punishing might be just as innocent as a newly-born little lamb. Thanks for reading  :)

title: Feeling like a soccer ball

replies.author: EncryptedShoesHD
replies.body:
Hey Jordanvk23!

Dort worry about it. There's no reason for feeling like you're a soccer ball :) However, the staff member who punished you, will reply soon!

Regards,
DSHD!

replies.author: SirCyaniide
replies.body:
Hey Jordan, 

     The player you identified in your story was kicked then temporarily banned from this server due to their actions. At the same time around 1:00 PM, I started noting others who were spleefing their teammates and one of them was you. I'm sorry if I gave you the wrong impression saying that you were the only one punished, but that wasn't the case. I saw you deliberately spleef another player (that was on your team) because they tried to spleef you. This infraction isn't so we can make you feel bad, non the less like a soccer ball. The purpose of this infraction was to warn you regarding your in-game behavior. I understand why you might be upset, but at the same time I don't think it would be fair if I only punish one person and let the other one off the hook. 

Long story short, this was just a slap on the wrist, and It happens to everyone. Therefore I see no reason why your punishment should be appealed, and or why its considered invalid. I also don't see why this is a big deal, others were temp-banned regarding their behavior, while others were merely kicked. I hope this clears some stuff up, and I hope you understand.

In conclusion, I'm going to have to Deny your appeal. 

[You can also review the rules by clicking here]

SirCyanide - Avicus Moderator

replies.author: Jordanvk23
replies.body:
Hey SirCyaniide,

Thanks for the reply (you too DeliciousShoesHD).

It's really not a big deal. I just wanted to tell you guys I honestly didn't do anything to deserve the kick, but I completely understand it must have been an honest mistake and realize being kicked is hardly a punishment. I also understand you might not feel you made a mistake and respect that as well.

About the whole appeal part of all of this, I may have been mistaken to place my complaint in this section of the forum as a kick is hardly worth the trouble of appealing, but I found it the most appropriate place to discuss my issue. I therefore have no problems with your denial.

I also admit I might have gotten a little carried away with my explanation as well as using "Feeling like a soccer ball", I just thought it would add a bit of humor to the situation.

Anyway, thanks for the replies and keep doing what you guys are doing, I understand it might not always be easy but you guys are doing a great job nonetheless.

Jordan
